cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 66% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.62%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -0.88%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +6.75%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +6.75%, WFRD +6.58%, GEV +4.39%, VRT +4.28%, BEP +3.65%. Laggards: EOSE -2.12%, MPC -1.76%, EQT -1.42%, ENPH -0.84%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
